
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/xiaoniu142857/p/23208501" title="发布于 2026-10-06 14:14">
    

    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">BS-2247 选钻石 题解</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body cnblogs-markdown">
<h2 id="题意">题意</h2>
<p>有一个长度为 <span class="math inline">\(n\)</span> 的随机数列 <span class="math inline">\(\{p_i\}\)</span>。每个 <span class="math inline">\(p_i\)</span> 独立等概率在 <span class="math inline">\(1\sim m\)</span> 中选取。</p>
<p>你选数的过程如下：</p>
<ul>
<li>从 <span class="math inline">\(i=1\)</span> 开始，每一步只能看到当前 <span class="math inline">\(p_i\)</span> 。你需要决策是否选择 <span class="math inline">\(p_i\)</span>：若选择，则直接结束；否则继续看 <span class="math inline">\(p_{i+1}\)</span>。</li>
<li>不能回头选择 <span class="math inline">\(i\)</span> 之前的数。</li>
</ul>
<p>最大化选出的数的期望，求出这个最大期望。</p>
<p><span class="math inline">\(1\le n\le 10^{9},2\le m\le 10^6\)</span>。</p>
<h2 id="solution">Solution</h2>
<p>由于每个数独立，<span class="math inline">\(i\)</span> 之前的数对 <span class="math inline">\(i\)</span> 处决策没有影响。不难得到一个 <span class="math inline">\(O(n)\)</span> 的 DP：</p>
<p>设 <span class="math inline">\(f_i\)</span> 为有 <span class="math inline">\(i\)</span> 个数的最大期望，答案即为 <span class="math inline">\(f_n\)</span>。</p>
<p>显然 <span class="math inline">\(f_1=(1+m)/2\)</span>。对于一个位置 <span class="math inline">\(i\)</span>：</p>
<ul>
<li>若 <span class="math inline">\(p_i\le f_{i+1}\)</span>（即 <span class="math inline">\(p_i\le \lfloor f_{i+1}\rfloor\)</span>）那么不选 <span class="math inline">\(p_i\)</span></li>
<li>否则选 <span class="math inline">\(p_i\)</span> 并退出</li>
</ul>
<p>综上，设 <span class="math inline">\(t=\lfloor f_{i-1} \rfloor\)</span>，转移方程为：</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[f_i=\frac{1}{m}\left(tf_{i-1}+\frac{(m-t)(m+t+1)}{2}\right)
\]</div><p></p><p>注意到 <span class="math inline">\(f\)</span> 满足：</p>
<ul>
<li><span class="math inline">\(f_i\)</span> 单调递增</li>
<li><span class="math inline">\(f_i&lt;m\)</span></li>
</ul>
<p>因此 <span class="math inline">\(\lfloor f_{i} \rfloor\)</span> 单调不降，当 <span class="math inline">\(\lfloor f_{i} \rfloor=m-1\)</span> 后不再改变。</p>
<p>我们先暴力 DP 直到 <span class="math inline">\(f_{i}\ge m-1\)</span>，设 <span class="math inline">\(a\)</span> 为第一个满足此条件的 <span class="math inline">\(i\)</span>。</p>
<p>此后转移方程变成：</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[f_i=\frac{m-1}{m}f_{i-1}+1\quad (i&gt;a)
\]</div><p></p><p>这是一个一阶线性递推，不动点法得：</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[f_i-m=\frac{m-1}{m}\left(f_{i-1}-m\right)\quad (i&gt;a)
\]</div><p></p><p>因此 <span class="math inline">\(f_n=(f_a-m)\left(\frac{m-1}{m}\right)^{n-a}+m\)</span>，快速幂解决即可。</p>
<h3 id="时间复杂度">时间复杂度</h3>
<p>我们可以证明，这个算法的时间复杂度是 <span class="math inline">\(O(m\log m)\)</span>。</p>
<p>引理</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[\forall x\in (0,+\infty),\quad \ln(1+x)\ge \frac{x}{1+x}
\]</div><p></p><p>首先考虑一个不优的策略：看到 <span class="math inline">\(m\)</span> 就拿，否则一直跳过。这个策略在 <span class="math inline">\(k\)</span> 个数时的期望为：</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[m\left(1-\left(\frac{m-1}{m}\right)^k\right)
\]</div><p></p><p>令</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[m\left(1-\left(\frac{m-1}{m}\right)^k\right)\ge m-1
\]</div><p></p><p>得</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[\begin{aligned}
m-m\left(\frac{m-1}{m}\right)^k&amp;\ge m-1  \\
\left(\frac{m-1}{m}\right)^k&amp;\le \frac{1}{m}  \\
\left(\frac{m}{m-1}\right)^k&amp;\ge m  \\
k&amp;\ge\log_{\frac{m}{m-1}}m  \\
k&amp;\ge\frac{\ln m}{\ln \left(1+\frac{1}{m-1}\right)}  \\
\end{aligned}
\]</div><p></p><p>又因为策略不优，有</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[\forall k\ge \frac{\ln m}{\ln \left(1+\frac{1}{m-1}\right)},\quad m-1\le m\left(1-\left(\frac{m-1}{m}\right)^k\right)\le f_k
\]</div><p></p><p>因此</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[a\le \frac{\ln m}{\ln \left(1+\frac{1}{m-1}\right)}
\]</div><p></p><p>令引理中 <span class="math inline">\(x=\frac{1}{m-1}\)</span>，得</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[\begin{aligned}
\ln \left(1+\frac{1}{m-1}\right) &amp;\ge \frac{1}{m}  \\
\frac{\ln m}{\ln \left(1+\frac{1}{m-1}\right)}&amp;\le m\ln m  \\
a&amp; \le m \ln m
\end{aligned}
\]</div><p></p><p>于是 DP 部分一定不会算超过 <span class="math inline">\(m\ln m\)</span> 个，算法时间复杂度为 <span class="math inline">\(O(m\log m)\)</span>。</p>
<h2 id="code">Code</h2>
<pre><code class="language-cpp">#include &lt;bits/stdc++.h&gt;
#define rept(i,a,b) for(int i(a);i&lt;=b;++i)
#define db double
using namespace std;
db ksm(db x,int y){
    db res=1;
    while(y){
        if(y&amp;1) res*=x;
        x*=x,y&gt;&gt;=1;
    }
    return res;
}
signed main(){
    int n,m,i=1,t;
    cin&gt;&gt;m&gt;&gt;n;
    cout&lt;&lt;fixed&lt;&lt;setprecision(3);
    db f=(m+1)/2.0;
    if(n==1) return cout&lt;&lt;f,0;
    while((t=floor(f))&lt;m-1){
        f=(f*t+1.0*(m+t+1)*(m-t)/2)/m,++i;
        if(i==n) return cout&lt;&lt;f,0;
    }
    cout&lt;&lt;(f-m)*ksm(1.0*(m-1)/m,n-i)+m;
    return 0;
}
</code></pre>
